map.遗物密度低就代表不重要的层位吗？: Does low artifact density mean an unimportant layer?
map.不一定。密度受保存条件、耕扰、发掘面积与筛选方式（是否浮选、过筛孔径）影响。低密: Not necessarily. Density is affected by preservation, plough disturbance, excavation area and screening method (whether floated, sieve aperture). A low-density layer may be a living floor later destroyed, or small pieces lost due to no flotation; judge with deposit nature.
map.为什么有的报告用块/立方米？: Why do some reports use pieces / m³?
map.对于柱坑、灰坑等三维堆积，除平面密度（件/m²）外还会用体积密度（件/m³）描述: For 3D deposits like post pits and ash pits, besides planar density (pieces/m²) they also use volumetric density (pieces/m³) to describe deposit content. The units differ; when citing, always note the denominator (area or volume), otherwise incomparable.
